name: The Lost Tools
summary: Blackrock fire has sunk Foreman Oslow's tools in Lake Everstill. With Lakeshire under pressure, local hands must maintain its defenses, and the tools shipped from Goldshire are needed to rebuild the shattered bridge.

sections.title: A Delivery Gone Awry
sections.body: The Great Bridge no longer connects Lakeshire to Elwynn Forest. A replacement shipment of stonemasonry and carpentry tools came overland from Goldshire, but the wagons could not reach town. The crew loaded the supplies into a rowboat to cross Lake Everstill. A Blackrock orc catapult struck the boat, destroying it and sending Oslow's heavy ironbound toolbox to the lake floor.

sections.title: Hazards of the Deep
sections.body: Lake Everstill holds dangers below its surface. Aggressive murloc tribes prowl the shallows, while predatory threshers hunt in the murky depths. Foreman Oslow needs his tools to resume repairs on the bridge and keep Lakeshire from falling further into ruin.

faq.q: Why were the tools sent by boat in the first place?
faq.answer: Blackrock orcs destroyed a large span of the stone bridge over Lake Everstill, so supply wagons from Goldshire could not reach Lakeshire. The crew unloaded the tools and tried to ferry them across the water.
Blackrock orcs struck the transport boat with a catapult projectile from the surrounding heights as it crossed Lake Everstill. The boat sank with its cargo.
Foreman Oslow is Lakeshire's chief builder and overseer, responsible for public works and civil maintenance. His most urgent work is rebuilding the ruined bridge.

faq.q: What threats are in Lake Everstill?
faq.answer: Hostile murloc tribes patrol the shores and ruins, while vicious, carnivorous lake threshers hunt in open water and the deeper depths.

faq.q: Why does Lakeshire need these tools so badly?
faq.answer: Lakeshire is under siege, cut off from immediate reinforcements and regular shipments. Without heavy tools, Oslow cannot rebuild the bridge or repair the defenses needed against attacking orcs and gnolls.

faq.q: Where does the quest lead next?
faq.answer: After his toolbox is recovered, Foreman Oslow asks adventurers to gather the raw building materials needed to repair the Great Bridge in The Everstill Bridge.

angles.text: As an Alliance traveler, you help Lakeshire hold the eastern frontier against the Blackrock clan. Civilian builders need their equipment to maintain the Kingdom of Stormwind's defenses.
As a blacksmith, you know quality tools are hard to forge under siege. Recovering the specialized smithing and construction implements sent from Goldshire matters to the town.
